Alex / Kimberly — quick ops note on telemetry vs training datasets.

1) Telemetry we collect: per-request metadata (latency, model variant, token counts), anonymized sampling of prompt length distributions for capacity planning, and error traces. Those items are aggregated and stored in a separate analytics pipeline (internal metrics cluster).
2) Training datasets: Redwood maintains a separate, access-controlled data store used only for model engineering. That store is populated from expressly consented opt-in programs and public datasets — customer tenant data is not present by default.
3) Evidence & attestations: we can produce a short ops statement describing the above, and we can provide a timestamped export (hash-signed) showing that no customer tenant keys were present in any training buckets for the last 12 months.

Operational caveat: if Silverline requests a fully air-gapped or on-prem model variant for stricter isolation we can discuss Redwood Private options (VPC/on-prem). That would be a separate commercial conversation (Dedicated/Private).

Let me know if you'd like examples of the audit exports; happy to produce a proof package for legal review.

- Dev
